description:
The seventh-generation Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon developed by the Kirijo Group.
As part of the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad (SEES), she is an android capable of summoning a Persona.
While she initially behaves like a machine, acting in an obedient and overly straightforward manner, she gradually comes to develop human emotions.

lines.text: Like the Nikkes, I too was born for combat. I can fight however much you need me to.
I require nothing aside from mission supplies.
I must return safely, for the sake of my mission.
Today's mission is to stand by? I see...

Not long ago, I had a conversation with Volt-san while Liter-san was performing maintenance on me. He told me she's been doing maintenance for decades now, and how her skills were... Commander? Why do you look so surprised?
My combat capabilities have been significantly enhanced. Thank you for your support.
It's break time. May I go to the Ark? I have an appointment with Beatrice.
Greetings. I am currently conversing with Max-san and Timi-san. Would you care to join us, Commander?
I was told this place is a military outpost... Why are there individuals dressed in maid outfits, swimsuits, and as bunny girls?
I am Aigis, the seventh-generation Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon. I will be joining you for now.
I can be of greater assistance now.
I will put this to good use.
Thank you for replenishing my supplies.
I will prepare something suitable in return.
I will repay the trust you have put in me.
Thank you. I look forward to your continued support.
Let us commence with an all-out attack!
